notes: Chart conditions: Exposure: 3200K Tungsten 1/50 sec; Process: ECN-2; Densitometry: ECN-2.
Only the negative characteristic curves (gamma, densityRange, exposureOffset) were fitted, to the digitized characteristic chart; every other parameter is the hand-tuned value of "Emulsion Default".
Minimum densities (base + fog + mask) were fitted (red 0.000, green 0.449, blue 0.677) but are not stored: the engine's calibrated printer lights absorb a constant per-layer density.
Exposure offsets are relative to mid-gray at log10 exposure -1.485 lux-seconds on the chart, an approximate anchor (see the fit report).
fitResiduals are measured − fitted density over the traced samples; they exclude the digitizing error.
red: fitted minimum density 0.000 sits on its bound, so it is not a reading of the film's base density (the logistic's long toe absorbs it); the lowest traced density is 0.189.
